dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I gathered the available data, did some analysis, and came up with some more effective battle strategies... Oh, I should write them down for her...

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: I wonder if she'll be surprised when she wakes up?

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Well, sleepwalking time's almost up. Keep an eye on her in battle, won't you?
